name: Witch Doctor: Umbral Glaive takes over every Hex of Malice button quietly and hands each back its own rank (#5761)
contract: The Umbral Glaive buff 504588 makes AscensionWitchDoctor::SyncReplacements replace every known Hex of Malice rank with Umbral Glaive 501134 through Player::SetTemporarySpellReplacement, and the buff's end hands them back. The swap used to reach the client as one SMSG_SUPERCEDED_SPELL per rank, which the client answers with a 'You have learned a new spell' chat line each time (#1506), and the reverts arrived in map order, so a button could come back holding rank 2 instead of the rank it had (#5761). With CoA.TemporarySpellReplacement.RedrawActionBar on, no superseded-spell packet is sent: the server writes the replacement into every button holding a Hex rank, records which rank each button held, resends the bar, and on revert restores each button's own rank. The saved bar never holds the temporary spell.

steps.label: Let login hooks and class synchronisation settle
The buff replaces the highest Hex of Malice rank with Umbral Glaive
Let the throttled sync run again
No superseded-spell packet is sent for the swap
The client's rank 6 button carries Umbral Glaive
The client's rank 2 button carries Umbral Glaive
The client's rank 1 button carries Umbral Glaive
The server's copy of the bar holds Umbral Glaive too
The rank 6 button is saved as rank 6, never as the temporary spell
The rank 2 button is saved as rank 2
The buff's end hands Hex of Malice back
Let the throttled sync run again
No superseded-spell packet is sent for the revert either
The rank 6 button gets rank 6 back (#5761)
The rank 2 button gets rank 2 back
The rank 1 button gets rank 1 back
The server's copy of the bar holds rank 6 again
